answer_1.quote: TrickCatcher combines LLMs and differential testing to accurately generate test inputs and test oracles. It consists of three steps: program variant generation, test input generation, and differential testing.
answer_1.outputs: program variants, input generators, and test inputs

answer_2.quote: We further define precision, recall, and F1-score: • Precision is defined as #TP / (#TP + #FP) • Recall is defined as #TP / (#TP + #FN) • F1 score is defined as 2×Precision×Recall / (Precision + Recall)
